description: A Collie Client reaches a remote Daemon, an Exposed Daemon, and starts a Run carrying the project file it read, which sets `tls.trusted_cas`. There the project file has only the run layer's authority, so the Daemon refuses the start with `setting_locked` at `project_configuration` (ADR 0083; story 11-75). A test replaces `/work/goodfetch.toml` with the path of the file its Client read.

error.message: `tls.trusted_cas` in project_configuration is refused: a project file sent to an Exposed Daemon has only the run layer's authority there: set `tls.trusted_cas` in the Daemon's own Operator policy or configuration, on its machine

data.fix: a project file sent to an Exposed Daemon has only the run layer's authority there: set `tls.trusted_cas` in the Daemon's own Operator policy or configuration, on its machine
